label: Distinct beings never depend for their being on each other
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise: no two distinct things depend for their being on each other; if x is distinct from y and x depends for its being on y, then y does not depend for its being on x. Restricted to distinct things so that it is neutral on self-dependence: on the literal counterfactual reading DependsForBeing holds trivially of a thing and itself, on a strict reading it never does, and the premise is compatible with either. It is exactly asymmetry of the distinct-step part of DependsForBeing. Navigation only (no claim): Aquinas, In V Metaph. lect. 13 n. 18, 'priora non dependent a posterioribus, sicut e converso'.
